lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance spots are organized in an ordered grid-like formation. Posterior to the gill region, spots are densely clustered with small diameters. Progressing posteriorly towards the caudal peduncle, spot diameter increases and the spatial distribution becomes more sparse, following distinct horizontal linear tracks.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of spots, particularly visible in the mid-flank section, creating a series of identifiable anchor nodes at the intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature runs across the upper third of the visible flank, exhibiting a sharp pixel intensity transition from light (dorsal) to dark (ventral) along its longitudinal axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct high-intensity white patch or irregular marking is visible on the trailing edge of the left pectoral fin, indicative of a potential scar or pigmentation anomaly.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple commensal organisms (remoras) are present as distinct pixel clusters, including one highly reflective individual situated ventrally near the pectoral fin and several lower-luminance individuals along the lower lateral line.
